notes: Jaag: ab 'Hey Jaraa' bolne se Jaraa jaagti hai. Laptop band khidki ke peeche bhi sunegi (Porcupine wake word, server me chalta hai) aur khidki khol kar session shuru kar degi - bas device unlocked ho (lock laga ho to taala nahi totega). Setup: Picovoice se AccessKey lo, 'Hey Jaraa' ki Windows .ppn file laptop ke wakeword folder me rakho, Sidebar ke naye 'Wake Word - Hey Jaraa' hisse me key daal kar ON karo aur mic (aksar WO Mic Device) chun lo. Saath me naya tray icon bhi hai - JARAA-TRAY.bat chalao, Jaraa system tray me baith jayegi.
